# macbox

> Run macOS, Xcode and the real iOS Simulator on a Linux host, in Docker, with GPU acceleration (Metal through Reims vGPU and metal2vulkan on the host's Vulkan GPU), for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and T3 Code. No Mac and no cloud service: one CLI, `macbox`, builds and runs it, and `mac-sim` gives each agent checkout its own iOS Simulator to build, run, tap, screenshot, record and measure at 60 fps.

License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 for macbox's own code (noncommercial use; commercial use needs permission); the patches stay GPL-2.0-or-later OR LGPL-3.0-or-later.

Requirements: an x86-64 Linux host with KVM, AVX2, an Intel or AMD GPU with a Mesa Vulkan driver, 16 GB RAM or more, about 150 GB of SSD, and Docker. It runs macOS 26 Tahoe, Xcode 26 and iOS 26 simulators, which is the ceiling on x86-64. Apple's license allows macOS only on Apple hardware.

- [README](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/README.md): what it is, requirements, quick start, performance, FAQ, comparison with Docker-OSX and cloud simulators
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for an agent setting macbox up on a host, including the steps in macOS's GUI (macbox screenshot, click, type)
- [Setup, step by step](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/docs/setup.md)

## Using it from an agent

- [The simulators skill](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/skills/simulators/SKILL.md): mac-sim and android-sim commands, T3 Code's Device panel, the verify-every-UI-change loop with sim-fps
- [Agents guide](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/docs/agents.md): installing the tools, the skill and the instructions
- [T3 Code's Device panel](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/docs/t3-code.md)
- [Phone builds](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/blob/main/skills/phone-builds/SKILL.md): .ipa / TestFlight / .apk with EAS, cloud first then local
